description: This file defines Express.js routes for managing shopping cart operations in an e-commerce backend, including adding, updating, retrieving, and removing cart items. It also contains Swagger documentation comments for API documentation.

methods.name: getCart
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's shopping cart.

methods.name: validateAdd
methods.description: Validates the request payload for adding an item to the cart.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds an item to the user's cart.

methods.name: validateUpdate
methods.description: Validates the request payload for updating a cart item's quantity.

methods.name: updateItem
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific cart item.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes an item from the cart.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart.
